items.text: 1.1.2 Hotfix Notes: ❗ Fixed text overlapping issues which used to occur while some of the retrospecting cutscenes are being played.: ❗ Fixed freezing characters during conversations on the streets.: 🐛 Also, fixed some cases where items are not registered for an auction.

1.1.0 Hotfix Notes: ❗ Fixed some cases where some of the achievements were not properly activated.: ❗ Fixed the error that didn't unlock new products in the hair shop AJIK HAIR, the clothing shop NICE T.: 🐛 Edited/Simplified some parts of the texts in ending scenes which used to overflow the screen and go unseen. It doesn't imply substantive changes in stories.
Hoochoo Game Studios brings you 1.0.6 release notes.
In this update, we've added some Halloween decorations and also focused on bug fixes and gameplay improvements.
In future updates, we promise to improve the English translation of the game and also to add more supported languages.
❗ macOS minimum system requirements is now version 10.13 instead of 10.12. If needed, please update your operating system.
🐛 1.0.7 Hotfix - Fixed cases where the customer thinks the player hid a card on the private slot when none was hidden.
Release Notes
✨ Missed the dialogue? No worries now! We've added a log you can browse to check back what the customer was saying.
✨ You can now collect all the game endings! In the past, only major game endings, excluding minor endings and game overs, were collectible.
🎨 Improved some parts of the tutorial for a more detailed explanation.
🎨 To prevent players from getting stuck by spending too much money on their first day before the tutorial, players will be given their start money once they enter the store on day 1.
🎨 Fixed some wrong item properties.
🎨 Added a new path for players concerning the blackmailer, who may this time be "not so certain".
🎨 Some street-view graphic layer orders have been fixed.
🐛 Fixed the invisible calendar button being able to be clicked in the street view.
🐛 Fixed the calendar not showing the overlay properly.
❗ We're working on an English translation overhaul. Please stay tuned!
❗ We're working on cases where the mouse disappears during the game. This may have been fixed by this update, but we're keeping our eyes on this issue.
❗ We're working on cases where players can get stuck in the flower shop in the challenge mode. This may have been fixed by this update, but we're keeping our eyes on this issue.
⚠️ Checking on graphic glitches in the street view
⚠️ Trying to fix cases where the player can fall of the elevator
⚠️ Working on a case where the bonus extra slot for the auction is not being applied correctly.
⚠️ Some UI elements in the tutorial are not fully translated.

items.text: 1.0.3 Hotfix Notes: ❗ Fixed some cases where endings could not be collected or viewed in the gallery.: ❗Fixed possible game freeze in certain situations during purchase event for the .: 🐛 Fixed player clothes not showing properly after viewing the game ending.: 🎨 Added more help for players having difficulty getting through the Wooden Sculpture purchase event.: ⚠️ Trying to fix cases where the mouse cursor goes missing.: ⚠️ We're looking into cases where the "inventory" tutorial doesn't recognize the player opening the inventory properly.: ⚠️ We're looking into cases where after each Friday's nightmare, the game does not save and continue but go back to the main menu.
❗ Fixed the game freezing, and dialogue becoming invisible in challenge mode when attempting to manage the display case just as the player is about to teleport to the other stores.
❗ Fixed some statistical data for the 'Notable Facts' not being recorded correctly.
🐛 Challenge mode - fixed an invisible event playing in the background with the customer's mouth synced to the hidden dialogue.
🐛 Fixed characters mixing up their lines in a certain event during day 4.
🐛 Fixed some street props' sprite layer order.

🐙 Purchased street-ridable hoverboard can be toggled with the hotkey 'H'. However, this is not very clear in-game, making it seem like the hoverboard was gone forever. A better guidance will be added in the future.
🎨 Changed the default spawn state to riding the hoverboard (if the player had purchased it.)
⚠️ We're looking into cases where the player's chosen outfit does not load properly.
⚠️ We're looking into cases where after each Friday's nightmare, the game does not save and continue but go back to the main menu.
⚠️ Trying to fix cases where the mouse cursor goes missing.
⚠️ We're looking into cases where the "inventory" tutorial doesn't recognize the player opening the inventory properly.
⚠️ Will be fixed in the next patch: not being able to collect endings after viewing the gallery or when collecting multiple endings in one game run.
❗ Fixed the game freezing in certain cases where a certain type of customer nags the player.
🐛 Removed a misplaced street character.
⚠️ We're looking into cases where the game can freeze in challenge mode while using any of the available stores.
Hoochoo Game Studios brings you the 0.11.7 release notes. Please check below for more details.

Starting today, we will now enable Steam auto-cloud, which syncs save files across devices. New saves will be synced, but already existing save files may not be included. Please refer to Steam's cloud FAQ for more.

A critical issue regarding steam cloud deleting local save files on Mac computers has been reported so steam cloud is now temporarily deactivated. This problem may likely occur when steam cloud fails to sync on some computers. Other game users on different game platforms have also went through the same problem, but unfortunately no proper solutions have been found to recover the lost files. Please email us at support@hoochoogamestudios.com if you also have this problem. We'll see if there's anything else we can help you with.
Steam FAQ - Steam Cloud
